_说明: 打法种类表。多段片子每段选一个“主打法”，相邻段不重复，整片至少用 6 类。工具/查重复.py 用这里的“认”正则数每段用了哪些。“写法”是可以整句搬进镜头的英文，<A> 出招的人、<B> 挨打的人。来由：2D 日漫测试 A 五段只用到 拳、腿、格挡、气功波、冲撞、空中追击 这几类，每段还是同一个节拍顺序，看片都说单一。另一种单一是“节拍单一”：每段都照作者六镜头顺序（对冲→快打→三连→特写→垂直下坠硬接→拉远收尾），五段就是同一个节奏放五遍。单段保留六镜头节奏，但第 1、3、5 镜在各段之间要换打法。已验证：日漫测试 C 就是按这张表每段换主打法写的，看片评价“动作非常完美”。注意按词数算会高估“拳脚连打”（伸缩拳的招全带 punch），这条提醒看实际镜头再判断。 兵器戏（11-18 补）：刀剑硬接、锁刀角力、击落缴械、后仰残影闪避、腾空下劈、兵器连斩 这几类是照 k3f、k4f 的写法补的；带“主兵器”标记的类（射箭、刀剑硬接）是这种兵器每个回合都会有的动作，查重复.py 不拿它算“某类太多”。带“要兵器”标记的类只在写到兵器的镜头里才数（徒手戏的 overhead strike 不算腾空下劈）。整段大半镜头都在用兵器时，查重复.py 不查近身手部细分。

类.认: punch|fist|\bjab|hook|uppercut|\bkick|knee
类.写法: <A> throws a fast combo—jab, hook, rising knee—each blow pulled back and thrown again in one continuous flow
类.适合: 近身快打。日漫测试 A 用得最多，一段最多一个镜头

类.认: \bblock|deflect|parr
类.写法: <B> deflects each blow with his forearms with zero lag, every block throwing a burst of sparks
类.适合: 防守。别让它连续几段都当主打法

类.认: catch(es)? (his|her|the) (fist|kick|foot|punch|blade|wrist)|traps? (his|her) (fist|arm|leg)
类.写法: <B> catches <A>'s fist bare-handed in mid-swing, the shockwave of the stopped punch blasting the dust behind them; both strain, then <B> twists the arm and counters
类.适合: 力量对比、剧情反转（主角第一次接住反派的拳）

类.认: grab|seiz|throws (him|her)|hurls (him|her)|tosses (him|her)|grappl|suplex|swings? (him|her) (around|by)|slams? (him|her) (into|onto|down)|wraps? (his|her|its) [a-z ]*arms? around|reels (him|her) in|by the throat|catches (him|her) in mid-air
类.写法: <A> grabs <B> by the arm, swings him around in a full circle and hurls him down into the ground, the tiles shattering in a crater
类.适合: 日漫测试 A 完全没有的一类；徒手戏最能拉开花样

类.认: headbutt|elbow
类.写法: <A> slams a headbutt into <B>'s forehead, both reeling back with a ringing crack
类.适合: 近身发狠、搞笑

类.认: teleport|vanish|reappear|feint|afterimage decoy|instant transmission
类.写法: <A>'s punch passes through an afterimage—<B> vanishes and reappears behind him; <A> spins and blocks just in time, then vanishes too, the two flickering across the battlefield
类.适合: 高手过招、心理战；节奏变化（打着打着突然空了一拳）

类.认: mid-air (combo|chase|exchange)|chases? (him|her) (up|into|across)|kicks? (him|her) (up )?into the sky|across the sky
类.写法: <A> kicks <B> into the sky and chases him upward, overtaking him and smashing him back down in a spiral of dust
类.适合: 换空间；一段最多一次

类.认: pillar|kicks? off (the|a) (wall|rock|cliff)|uproots?|rips? up|hurls? (a|the) (boulder|rock|pillar)|bounces? off
类.写法: <A> rips a stone pillar out of the ground and swings it like a club; <B> shatters it with one punch, rubble raining down
类.适合: 场景互动；每段的场景物件不同就自然不重复

类.认: pinned|pins (him|her)|ground and pound|roll(s|ing) across the ground|on (his|her) back
类.写法: <A> pins <B> to the ground and pounds him, <B> twists free and rolls away as the ground caves in under the next punch
类.适合: 落差：从天上打到地上

类.认: launch(es)? (him|her) (into|up)|juggl|spikes? (him|her)
类.写法: <A> launches <B> upward with a rising kick, juggles him with three blows in mid-air and spikes him back down
类.适合: 格斗游戏感；作为三连反击的变体

类.认: \bbeam|ki blast|energy wave|kamehameha|wave of (ki|energy)|air blade|crescent|stretching (rubber )?punch|arm shoots out
类.写法: <A> cups his hands and fires a blazing beam; <B> swats it aside and it blows apart a distant mesa
类.适合: 远程；别每段都放；也包括气刃踢气刃、伸缩远程拳这类隔空出手

类.认: beams? (collide|clash|lock|meet)|beam struggle|push(es)? (the|his) beam
类.写法: the two beams collide between them and lock, both straining as the clash point swings back and forth, the ground peeling away beneath them
类.适合: 决战段的高潮；整片只用一次

类.认: supersonic charge|charges? (at|toward)|dash(es)? (at|toward)|rams? into
类.写法: both burst forward at the same instant in a supersonic charge
类.适合: 开场；日漫测试 A 每段第 1 镜都是它，换成别的开场（瞬移偷袭、从地下钻出、扔石柱）

类.认: snakes? (bite|snap|go limp)|fans? roar like|drumstick (drops|falls)|like a gong|blower
类.写法: the two little snakes on his staff bite the edge of the card and get their teeth stuck
类.适合: 喜剧片：把人物的道具和台词梗演进打斗里（射雕：小蛇咬卡、风扇鼓风机、一脚“踢出董事局”）

类.认: \b(long)?bows?\b|\b(fires?|shoots?|looses?|nocks?|releases?) [a-z' ]{0,25}arrows?\b|\barrows? (strikes?|hits?|pierces?|streaks?|slams?)|(storm|rain|volley) of [a-z ]*arrows
类.写法: still running, <A> turns at the waist and looses three arrows in rapid succession at supersonic speed, each a streak of green wind that strikes <B>'s armor in a burst of sparks
类.适合: 远程兵器（弓、弩、飞刀）。边跑边回身射、腾空箭雨、贴身连射、最后一箭射穿要害（浮桥追逐，11-16 人工“特别优秀”）

类.认: \bchas(e|es|ing)\b|runs? (along|toward|across)|wades? after|flees?|pursu
类.写法: a fast tracking shot running alongside <A> at plank level, staying on the same side: she runs toward the left, <B> wades after her on the right
类.适合: 一方逃一方追，换空间、拉节奏；跟拍写明谁往哪跑、追的人在哪一侧（浮桥追逐）

类.认: (runs?|sprints?|climbs?) up (its|his|the) (fore)?arm|(lands?|leaps?|jumps?) (across the gap )?onto (its|his|the) (fore)?arm|off (its|his|the) (golem's |giant's )?shoulder|climbs? (onto|up) (its|his)
类.写法: <A> leaps onto <B>'s outstretched arm and runs straight up it toward the shoulder, firing point-blank as she goes
类.适合: 以小打大：沿手臂往上跑、从肩头腾空、贴身打要害（浮桥追逐第 2 段）。巨物的手要写整条手臂和身体都在画面里

类.认: wraps? (around|round) (his|her|the) (staff|fan|blade|sword|spear|arm)|whip wraps
类.写法: the whip wraps around the middle of <B>'s staff; he plants his feet and yanks, pulling <A> off her feet toward him
类.适合: 软兵器（鞭、链、绳镖）对长兵器：缠住→拽→借力反打（石窟二对二）

类.认: steps? in (behind|in front of) (him|her|<subject \d>)|steps? onto the other end|back to back|the pairs swap|covers? (his|her) (partner|ally)|saves? (him|her) from
类.写法: <A> plants one end of his staff in the sand; <C> runs up and steps onto the other end, and <A> heaves the staff upward, launching him high into the air
类.适合: 二对二、多人：替同伴挡招、用兵器把同伴撑上天、背靠背、冲锋中换对手（石窟二对二）

类.认: crosses (his|her) (twin )?(sabres|swords|blades|daggers)|catches the (dart|blade|sabre|sword|spearhead|tip)[a-z' ]{0,30}(between|in the cross)|(sabre|blade|sword) slides? down between (two )?(ribs|blades)|traps? (the|his|her) (blade|sabre|sword|spear|dart) (between|in)
类.写法: <A> crosses her twin sabres in front of her like open scissors and catches <B>'s blade in the cross of the blades with a ringing clang, then snaps the blades shut and yanks; the weapon is ripped out of <B>'s hand
类.适合: 双刀、扇、叉这类能“夹”的兵器的招。夹住→一拧/一拽→对方脱手，三步都写出来（石窟第 6 段镜 1 验证过）

类.认: (blade|sabre|sword|spear|shaft|staff) snaps? in two|snaps? (in two|clean in half)|breaks? into two halves|broken hilt|broken half of the (blade|sabre|sword|spear)|(sword|sabre|blade|spear|axe|whip) is ripped out of|ripped out of (his|her) hands?|(hilt|sabre|sword) drops (into|onto) the sand
类.写法: in one fluid motion the trapped blade snaps in two with a sharp crack, the upper half spinning high into the air; <B>'s hand opens and the broken hilt drops into the sand
类.适合: 缴械、折刃。断要写成看得见的结果（上半截翻着飞上天），只写“手腕一拧就断”H3 画不出来（石窟第 6 段镜 3）

类.认: (outward|inward) circle|presses? (his|her|the [a-z']+) (arm|blade|spear|staff) down|(spear|staff) butt|blunt butt|butt (of the|of his|of her) (spear|staff)
类.写法: <A> turns the spear in a small outward circle and the shaft sweeps <B>'s strike wide, reverses into an inward circle and presses <B>'s arm down, then flips the spear around and drives the blunt butt into <B>'s chest; <B> folds in half and slides back across the ground
类.适合: 长枪、长棍的拦、拿、扎（枪尾顶）。两头都能用，比只用枪尖戳好看（石窟第 6 段镜 2 验证过）

类.认: turning thrust|turns? (his|her) back as if|spins and whips the (spear|staff|sword|sabre|blade)|knocks? the [a-z ]{0,12}helmet
类.写法: <A> turns his back as if to step away, then spins and whips the spear back around in one turning thrust; brief slow-motion as the spearhead streaks over <B>'s head and knocks the helmet clean off
类.适合: 回马枪、回身剑一类的诈败反击，做收尾一招。挑盔、挑冠、挑发带都行，别直取要害（石窟第 6 段镜 5 验证过）

类.认: hard-blocks?|catch(es)? (it|the cut|the slash|the blow|the strike) on (his|her)|edge (to|against) edge|blade against blade|meets? it (edge|blade)
类.写法: <B> hard-blocks it with her blade raised level above her head, edge grinding against edge in a shower of sparks, instantly dissipates the force and throws <A> back
类.适合: 兵器戏的基本回合：写明兵器架在哪、两把兵器在两人之间相碰。一段里别每个回合都是它

类.认: blades? (stay |are |stays? )?lock|lock(ed|s)? (blades|together|and grind)|crossed (in an x|and locked)|weapons lock|grind(s|ing)? (against each other|face to face)
类.写法: their blades lock between them, crimson light and purple flame grinding against each other, sparks exploding
类.适合: 段落之间的接缝（上一段停在锁刀特写，下一段从锁刀接）；一段最多一次

类.认: out of (his|her) (hand|grip|hands)|beats? (his|her) [a-z]+ down|knock(s|ing)? (the|his|her) [a-z]+ (out|away|from)|lying out of (his|her|their) reach|disarm
类.写法: <A> spins and strikes his blade near the hilt, knocking the jian out of his hand; it spins through the air and stabs into the stone floor far behind him
类.适合: 留手的结局：打飞兵器、刀垂身侧，不会被画成刺中

类.认: bends? (backward|back) under|(cuts|hits|strikes|sweeps through) only (her|his|an) afterimage|only (cuts|hits|strikes) (her|his|an) afterimage|ducks? under (it|the)|leaps? over (it|the)|vaults? over (the|its|his|her)|rolls? aside
类.写法: <B> bends backward under it, the flame wave sweeping over her, then springs upright in one fluid motion
类.适合: 对付横扫；比“朝人直刺再让开”稳，兵器不会画到人身上

类.认: overhead (strike|chop|cut)|(leaps?|vaults?|springs?) [a-z ,'-]{0,60}(brings?|drives?|chops?|cuts?) [a-z ,'-]{0,40}down|spinning cut|from the top of (his|her) arc
类.写法: <A> leaps and brings the blade down in an overhead strike; <B> hard-blocks it, the ground cracking in radiating lines beneath her feet
类.适合: 一段里的重击；接“硬接后地面开裂”

类.认: three (ultra-high-speed |rapid )?(strikes|slashes|cuts)|flurry of [a-z ]*(slashes|cuts|chops)|(horizontal slash|upward thrust|spinning cut)[a-z ,]{0,30}(upward thrust|spinning cut)
类.写法: <A> answers with three ultra-high-speed strikes, each one shown clearly: a horizontal slash, an upward thrust, a spinning cut, each one striking his jian and leaving a sharp scarlet arc hanging in the air
类.适合: 压制对手；每一下写清打在对方兵器上

近身细分_说明: 近身手部对打的细分。日漫测试 A 的近身镜头写的都是笼统词：trade punches and kicks at blinding speed、a furious close-range combo、a frantic flurry of punches and kicks、fists crashing together，H3 就画成同一种你一拳我一拳，看片说“像早年的老动画”。写法：每个近身镜头写 ≥ 3 个具体回合，每个回合写成“<A> 出什么招 → <B> 怎么接/怎么挨”，回合之间换招式、换部位（头/腹/腿/手腕）、换方向；每一下挨打要有看得见的反应（头被打偏、身体对折、被推得滑出去）。整片至少用 6 种细分，同一种最多用 2 次；“对拳互抵”最容易用烂，整片最多 1 次。工具/查重复.py 会数。

近身细分.写法: <B> slaps <A>'s straight punch aside with an open palm, steps inside the guard and drives an elbow into <A>'s ribs
近身细分.适合: 高手的从容，防守变进攻

近身细分.写法: <B> catches <A>'s wrist mid-punch, twists the arm outward and yanks <A> off balance straight into a rising knee
近身细分.适合: 力量/技巧压制，接下一招

近身细分.写法: their forearms smash together with a ringing crack and a ring of shockwave, both sliding back a step on scraping feet
<B> ducks under <A>'s hook so close the fist ruffles his hair, then rams his shoulder into <A>'s chest, knocking the wind out of him
<A> feints a high jab; as <B>'s guard rises, <A> drops low and hammers a punch into his exposed stomach
<A> spins a full turn and whips a backfist across <B>'s jaw, snapping his head sideways
<A> pulls <B> in and drives a knee deep into his stomach; <B> folds in half around it, spit flying, eyes bulging
近身细分.适合: 碾压、一招制服（少年打反派）

近身细分.写法: <A> thrusts the heel of his palm up under <B>'s chin, snapping his head back and lifting him off his feet
<B> sways his head aside by a hair; <A>'s fist grazes his cheek, the wind of it whipping his hair back, and <B> doesn't even blink
近身细分.适合: 表现差距、冷静（变身后的少年）

近身细分.写法: they swing at the same instant and both fists land—a cross-counter—each face snapping sideways, both skidding back and glaring
<A>'s punch smashes into <B>'s crossed-arm guard and blasts the arms apart, leaving him wide open for the follow-up
<A> drops and sweeps <B>'s legs out from under him, then launches him into the air with a rising kick
<A> grabs <B> by the collar, pins him against the rock face and hammers knees into his body one after another
their fists meet head-on, a sphere of shockwave exploding outward and carving the ground in a ring
近身细分.适合: 最容易用烂，整片最多 1 次
